App-specific limits accumulate across visits until a break starts. The first reached rule requests one break. Pause, quiet hours and focus schedules take priority.
No budget rule is enabled. Usage can still be measured, but no automatic break will be requested.
Use local time. Overnight windows belong to their starting weekday. Equal start/end times mean the entire selected day. Manual pause and quiet hours still apply; Resume does not override them.
Select at least one day to allow scheduled monitoring.
No measurements recorded in this period.

Only observed intervals are included. Missing monitoring time is unknown. Break time is not proof of attention, productivity, or time saved. Daily totals are kept locally for 35 recorded days; deleting history removes them.
Diagnostics contain up to 100 timestamps and fixed status codes. They exclude app selections, usage totals, purchase tokens and exception text. Export only if you want to save a support file.
